label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into the LDAP filter string via concatenation ('|(uid='+bar+')') without any effective sanitization. The doSomething function preserves the original user input by removing only the first list element ('safe'), leaving the second element (the original param) intact. ESAPI.encodeForHTML is used later for display purposes but does not sanitize the filter string itself, allowing potential LDAP injection attacks.

evidence.note: doSomething removes only the first safe value, preserving the original user input in bar.
Unsafe concatenation of user-controlled bar into LDAP filter string.
